Individual covariate associations with auction volume

Primary target: closing-auction shares. Retrospective analysis of eligible 2015–2025 observations. Association does not establish causality or incremental forecast value.

Stock-date bin plots retain the target in shares. Shared market/calendar primary correlations use dates; sector context uses sector-dates. Secondary ranks use a deterministic 7% stock-date sample, or all native context observations. No IID p-values are reported.

Current-day outcomes and intraday inputs are marked separately from permissible prior-close information. All 58 selected model features have individual entries.
